RegionBehavior.er-qol.regionLighting: Emit light or darkness using the Region's full shape, including its elevation range.
RegionBehavior.er-qol.regionWall: Turn the Region boundary into a wall-like blocker for movement, light, sight, sound, and optionally darkness.
RegionBehavior.er-qol.regionAnnounce: Post a notification or chat message when a token enters or leaves this Region.
RegionBehavior.er-qol.regionTeleport: Teleport tokens that enter this Region to a destination scene or coordinate.

REGION_LIGHTING.label: Region Lighting
REGION_LIGHTING.hint: Emit light or darkness using the Region's full shape, including its elevation range.

priority.hint: At values above 0, the Region contributes priority source edges so it can override lower-priority light or darkness.

type.hint: Choose a registered Foundry light animation. Leave empty for a static Region light.

REGION_WALLS.label: Region Walls
REGION_WALLS.hint: Turn the Region boundary into a wall-like blocker for movement, light, sight, sound, and optionally darkness.

move.label: Block Movement
move.hint: Prevent tokens from crossing this Region boundary.

sight.label: Block Sight
sight.hint: Prevent line of sight and visibility checks from crossing this Region boundary.

light.label: Block Light
light.hint: Prevent light sources from projecting through this Region boundary.

sound.label: Block Sound
sound.hint: Prevent sound sources from projecting through this Region boundary.

darkness.label: Block Darkness
darkness.hint: Prevent darkness sources from projecting through this Region boundary.

direction.label: Blocking Direction
direction.hint: Choose whether the boundary blocks both directions or only one direction relative to the Region interior.

REGION_ANNOUNCE.label: Region Announce
REGION_ANNOUNCE.hint: Post a notification or chat message when a token enters or leaves this Region.

notifyEntry.label: Announce Entry
notifyEntry.hint: Announce when a token enters this Region.

notifyExit.label: Announce Exit
notifyExit.hint: Announce when a token leaves this Region.

entryMessage.label: Entry Message
entryMessage.hint: Optional. Supports {token} and {region}. Leave empty to use the default text.

exitMessage.label: Exit Message
exitMessage.hint: Optional. Supports {token} and {region}. Leave empty to use the default text.

output.label: Output
output.hint: Send the announcement as a UI notification or as a chat message.

REGION_TELEPORT.label: Region Teleport
REGION_TELEPORT.hint: Teleport tokens that enter this Region to a destination scene or coordinate.

scene.label: Destination Scene
scene.hint: Scene id to teleport to. Leave empty to teleport within the current scene.

consume.label: Use Cooldown
consume.hint: When enabled, a teleported token cannot trigger the same destination Region again until the cooldown expires.

notify.label: Notify Owner
notify.hint: Show a notification to the GM and the token's owner after the teleport.

destinationRegion.label: Arrival Region Name
destinationRegion.hint: Optional. Name of the Region the token lands in. Standing inside that Region on the destination scene clears the cooldown.

NOTIFY.noScene: Region Teleport: destination scene was not found.
NOTIFY.needGm: Region Teleport: changing scene requires the GM.

hoverHighlight.name: Hover Highlight
hoverHighlight.hint: Highlight a Region's outline when the mouse hovers over it.

hoverInfo.name: Hover Info
hoverInfo.hint: Show a small info notice (behaviors and elevation range) when hovering a Region.

teleportCooldown.name: Teleport Cooldown (ms)
teleportCooldown.hint: How long a token is immune to Region Teleport after being teleported. Set to 0 to disable.

wallHint.name: Wall Outlines On Other Layers
wallHint.hint: Draw a thin line for every wall even when the Walls layer is not active, so players can see where the real wall lines are. Uses one uniform color instead of the per-type wall colors, so secret doors are not revealed.

wallHintColor.name: Wall Outline Color
wallHintColor.hint: Uniform color used for the wall outline hints. Deliberately not the Walls-layer color, which would give secret doors away.

wallHintWidth.name: Wall Outline Width
wallHintWidth.hint: Line width in pixels at the current UI scale.

wallHintOpacity.name: Wall Outline Opacity
wallHintOpacity.hint: Opacity of the wall outline hints.

wallHintScope.name: When To Show Wall Outlines
wallHintScope.hint: Other Layers hides the hints while the Walls layer is active (you already see the real walls there); Always keeps them visible.

wallHintShowSecret.name: Include Secret Doors
wallHintShowSecret.hint: Also draw the outline hint for secret doors. Off by default: the hint would reveal them to players.
